process: A man is running forward along a curved running track, moving steadily away from the camera around the bend.
away_prompt: A wide green grass infield beside a curving red running track with white lane lines, under a clear blue sky. Beyond the track, a dark metal railing runs along a grassy strip, and a row of tall leafy green trees stands in full summer foliage. Bright natural sunlight, crisp realistic photographic style, with the grass and track continuing to the far edge of the frame.

sources.fact: In a study of 37,201 everyday runs, the average preferred running speed was about 3.25 m/s for men and 2.74 m/s for women, so a male runner covers roughly 16 m in 5 seconds.

stages.prompt: A man wearing a red shirt and black shorts is running forward along a curved red rubber running track marked with white lines, passing a large blank white rectangular wall standing on the adjacent green grass. Tall green trees and a clear blue sky stand behind the track, in bright daylight.

stages.state: about 8 m further along the curve
stages.prompt: A man wearing a red shirt and black shorts has run further along the curved red rubber running track marked with white lines, now smaller in the frame and nearer the bend of the track.
